unit: Independent process run; frames/windows within run remain correlated; same-sequence runs do not constitute independent scene sampling
after_pilot: Assess backlog counts, run-level variation, temporal dependence and obtainable precision; then predeclare development/check/holdout acquisition. Inspected pilot data are never relabeled holdout.
stop: Do not continue downstream after substantive practical/measurement failure; diagnose without tuning gates or discarding failed data.
no_failure_requirement: No observed deadline misses is not a failure of collection and does not establish reliability=1.
